$comment: Sŏn adherence — CSS/HTML pass. Canon-critical rules run at error severity: a violation blocks. Pairs with adherence/check-copy.mjs (copy rules: em dashes, forbidden lexicon, removed tokens) and _adherence.oxlintrc.json (JSX). Requires postcss-html for the .html overrides.

color-no-hex.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var(--son-*). The only hex lives in tokens/colors.css primitives and the gold-foil stripe in guidelines/colors-special.html.

color-named.message: Named CSS color — use a design-system color token via var(--son-*).

function-disallowed-list.message: Raw color function — the palette is closed; use var(--son-*) (color-mix over tokens is the sanctioned alpha mechanism).

/^font-family$/: /^(var\(--son-font-[a-z-]+\)|"?(GT Sectra Book Fallback|GT Sectra Book|GT Sectra Display|GT Sectra|GT Alpina|Sandoll Myeongjo|Nanum Myeongjo|Apple Myungjo|Batang|Georgia)"?|inherit|serif)([,].*)?$/

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Font not provided by the design system. Use var(--son-font-*) or: GT Sectra Book, GT Sectra, GT Sectra Display, GT Alpina, Sandoll/Nanum Myeongjo (+ sanctioned serif fallbacks).
